Faza Meonk

IP & Creative Development

Creator of Si Juki, an Indonesian character IP spanning comics, animation and brand collaborations.

Faza created Si Juki under PIONICON IP Management. His work shows how a character can develop into a wider creative and commercial ecosystem across publishing, animation, games and collaborations.

Character IP · Storytelling · Licensing · Creative worlds

  • 65+ printed comic titles reported by Si Juki.
  • 100+ brand collaborations across the IP ecosystem.

Rinintha Pradiza

Strategy & Cross-Market Projects

15+ years connecting strategy, brands and complex projects across Indonesia and Japan.

Rinintha combines market understanding, creative direction and delivery. Her experience spans Japanese Station, JETRO-initiated Japan Wave Expo, K-Content Expo Indonesia, fashion market development and original live properties.

Strategy · Research · Partnerships · Project leadership

  • Created Hyper Wave Festival, with 5,000+ attendees.
  • Led Nila Baharuddin’s Japan market development.
